declaration.preface:
The Ethical Standard Policy of NewLife Medicals defines the principles, standards, and expectations that guide ethical behavior and responsible decision-making across the organization. It serves as a foundational framework to ensure that all business activities are conducted with integrity, transparency, and accountability, in compliance with applicable laws and industry standards.

The policy addresses key ethical risk areas including anti-bribery and corruption, fraud prevention, conflicts of interest, fair competition, information security and confidentiality, anti-money laundering, ethical marketing, and responsible third-party management. It establishes mandatory controls, outlines clear responsibilities, reporting mechanisms, disciplinary consequences, and oversight responsibilities to ensure effective implementation and independent monitoring.
declaration.declaration:
The objectives of the Ethical Standard Policy at NewLife Medicals are to:

Establish clear ethical principles and standards to guide decision-making and behavior across all business activities.

Promote a culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, and fairness at every level of the organization.

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards governing pharmaceutical and healthcare operations.

Prevent, detect, and respond to bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, financial crime, and other misconduct through structured internal controls and enforcement mechanisms.

Protect confidential information, intellectual property, and personal data of employees, customers, and business partners.
declaration.scope:
This Policy applies to all operations of NewLife Medicals, including its offices, subsidiaries, warehouses, distribution activities, and global sourcing and supply chain operations.

It applies to all directors, employees, management, contract workers, consultants, agents, distributors, suppliers, and other business partners acting on behalf of or representing the Company.

This Policy applies across all jurisdictions in which the Company operates and extends to cross-border transactions and third-party engagements.

Corruption and Bribery: We are committed to rejecting gifts, hospitality, or incentives that may influence decision-making.

We are committed to maintaining a zero-tolerance approach toward bribery and corruption across all sourcing, clinical trial supply, export, and regulatory activities to protect patient safety, regulatory integrity, and global business credibility.

We aim to conduct all transactions with transparency, fairness, and accountability, ensuring that no employee, agent, distributor, or third-party representative offers, gives, or receives any improper advantage to secure business benefits.

We commit to implementing strong internal controls, approval mechanisms, and documentation procedures to prevent unethical payments, facilitation payments, or kickbacks, particularly in high-risk areas such as international procurement and regulatory submissions.
We strive to provide regular ethics and anti-corruption awareness training to employees to help them identify and prevent bribery risks.

We maintain strict due diligence processes for suppliers, logistics partners, and intermediaries to ensure alignment with anti-corruption laws such as the Prevention of Corruption Act (India) and applicable international regulations.
We continue to enhance transparency in gifts, hospitality, sponsorships, donations, and interactions with government officials and customers
We encourage employees to report suspected unethical conduct through confidential reporting channels, ensuring protection against retaliation.

To strengthen governance and minimize ethical and compliance risks, we will implement robust internal controls such as structured authorization workflows, defined role segregation, and formal conflict-of-interest declarations.
Fraud Prevention: We are committed to upholding the highest standards of integrity and accuracy in all financial activities, ensuring that no form of fraud, falsification of documents, or manipulation of records is tolerated within the organization.

We aim to establish and maintain robust internal control systems, segregation of duties, and multi-level approval mechanisms to prevent fraudulent activities in procurement, clinical supply distribution, export documentation, invoicing, and financial reporting.

We commit to ensuring complete transparency and traceability in product sourcing and documentation, particularly in RLD sourcing, API exports, and named patient supply services, to eliminate risks of duplicate invoicing, or false certifications.

We strive to conduct periodic internal audits and risk-based assessments to proactively identify vulnerabilities in supply chain transactions, customs documentation, regulatory filings, and vendor payments before they escalate into material fraud risks.

We maintain strict verification and due diligence procedures for suppliers, distributors, and third-party intermediaries to prevent fraudulent misrepresentation of licenses, product authenticity, or compliance certifications.
We will conduct regular training programs for employees on fraud prevention to enhance awareness across the organization.
Conflict of Interest: We are committed to ensuring that all business decisions are made objectively and in the best interest of NewLife Medicals, without undue personal, financial, or relational influence. The company shall maintain zero undisclosed conflicts of interest annually.

We aim to prevent situations where personal relationships with suppliers, customers, regulators, or competitors may compromise impartial judgment, particularly in procurement, contract negotiations, and regulatory dealings.
A structured conflict of interest framework will be implemented, including regular disclosure requirements, defined oversight roles, and formal documentation of corrective and mitigative actions.
We are committed to maintaining an open and transparent environment where conflicts are assessed objectively and managed to safeguard the Company’s integrity and interests.

We prohibit the use of company position, confidential information, or business opportunities for personal gain, including engaging in competing activities or influencing vendor selection for personal benefit.

We promote awareness and periodic guidance on identifying conflict-of-interest risks, especially in high-risk functions such as sourcing of RLDs, API procurement, distributor appointments, and international partnerships.
We aim to ensure that all employees proactively disclose actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest that may affect business decisions.
Information Security and Confidentiality: We are committed to safeguarding all confidential, and sensitive information, , against unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse.

We aim to implement robust information security controls, including restricted access, password protection, secure data storage, and controlled document sharing, to maintain the integrity and confidentiality of business-critical information.

We require all employees, and third-party partners to maintain strict confidentiality obligations, particularly when handling comparator drug sourcing data, named patient supply records, export documentation, and regulatory submissions.

We prohibit the unauthorized sharing, copying, or transmission of company or client information, whether verbally, electronically, or in printed form, including through personal devices or unsecured communication channels.

We aim to implement robust information security controls, including role-based access mechanisms, firewall protection, restricted system access, strong password protocols, secure data storage, and controlled document sharing, to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of business-critical information.

We commit to ensuring compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations, especially in relation to international clients, cross-border transactions, and sensitive healthcare-related information.

We promote regular awareness and training programs on cybersecurity risks and data protection practices, enabling employees to identify threats such as phishing, data breaches, or unauthorized system access and take preventive action.
Anti-Money Laundering: We are committed to conducting business only with legitimate clients, suppliers, and partners, ensuring that all funds received or paid are derived from lawful and transparent sources.
A formal AML framework will be established to ensure effective due diligence, ongoing transaction oversight, clear escalation mechanisms, and thorough documentation.
We uphold financial integrity by maintaining transparent processes, ensuring transaction traceability, and enforcing strict authorization and record-keeping controls across all financial activities.

We aim to implement risk-based customer and supplier due diligence procedures, including verification of legal status, beneficial ownership, regulatory licenses, and banking credentials prior to onboarding.
Sanctions screening and beneficial ownership verification shall be mandatory prior to onboarding customers or third parties.
We commit to maintaining accurate, complete, and transparent financial records, ensuring that all invoices, contracts, and payment trails are properly documented and auditable.
We maintain strict compliance with applicable anti-money laundering laws and financial regulations, including all applicable laws to the Group and relevant international trade compliance standards.
Cash transactions exceeding statutory limits are strictly prohibited.

We aim to provide periodic training and awareness programs to employees involved in finance, procurement, export, and regulatory coordination, enabling them to identify and report potential money laundering risks.
Ethical Marketing and Third-Party Conduc: We are committed to ensuring that all marketing, promotional, and business development activities are accurate, evidence-based, and compliant with applicable pharmaceutical and trade regulations, avoiding misleading claims, exaggerated representations, or unsubstantiated product comparisons.

We aim to promote our services such as comparator sourcing, API and FDF supply, and clinical trial supply support through transparent and responsible communication, ensuring that all information shared with clients reflects verified data and approved documentation.
We commit to conducting integrity-based screening and risk assessments prior to engaging third parties, particularly in high-risk international markets and regulatory interactions.

responsibilities.duty: Provide independent oversight of the Company’s ethical conduct, compliance framework, and internal control environment.
Review the effectiveness of the Ethical Standard Policy, whistleblower mechanism, and investigation processes on a periodic basis.
Monitor significant ethics violations, fraud cases, regulatory breaches, and remediation actions, ensuring appropriate corrective measures are implemented.
Oversee the adequacy of internal controls, risk management systems, and compliance monitoring mechanisms related to bribery, fraud, conflicts of interest, AML, and data security.
Review findings from internal audits, external audits, and compliance assessments concerning ethical risks and ensure timely management response.
Escalate material ethical or compliance matters to the Board, where necessary, and ensure transparent reporting in governance disclosures.
Approve significant revisions to the Ethical Standard Policy where required under applicable governance norms.
Provide overall leadership and set the “tone at the top” for ethical conduct and compliance.
Ensure the Ethical Standard Policy is effectively implemented and integrated into business strategy and operations.
Review key ethics risks, incident trends, and policy effectiveness at least annually.
Approve significant updates to the Ethical Standard Policy and related governance frameworks.
Lead the implementation and day-to-day management of the Ethical Standard Policy.
Develop procedures, controls, and guidance to support ethical conduct across functions.
Conduct ethics risk assessments, coordinate training programs, and monitor compliance performance.
Receive, assess, and investigate reported ethics concerns in a fair, confidential, and impartial manner.
Escalate significant violations and investigation outcomes to senior management.
Review policy regularly
Ensure employees within their functions understand and comply with the Ethical Standard Policy.
Integrate ethical considerations into operational decisions, procurement, and third-party engagements.
Review and approve sensitive activities such as vendor selection, sponsorships, gifts, and interactions with healthcare professionals.
Support employees who raise concerns and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
Support policy implementation through onboarding, training, and awareness programs.
Ensure ethical conduct is embedded in performance management and disciplinary processes.
Maintain records related to policy acknowledgment, training completion, and disciplinary actions.
Understand and comply with the Ethical Standard Policy and applicable procedures.
Follow the guidelines and acknowledge the violation outcomes
Act with integrity, honesty, and accountability in all business activities.
Disclose conflicts of interest and avoid participation in unethical practices.
Promptly report suspected misconduct, violations, or unethical behavior without fear of retaliation.

policy.monitoring: NewLife Medicals is committed to continuously strengthening its ethical framework through regular monitoring and improvement of its Ethical Standards Policy and related practices. The Company reviews ethics controls, procedures, and awareness programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and industry best practices. Through internal audits, compliance assessments, and management reviews, the Company monitors adherence across operations and third-party engagements. Findings, reported incidents, and employee feedback are analyzed to identify risks and improvement areas, leading to enhanced policies, stronger controls, updated training, and improved communication to promote integrity and accountability.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Ethical Policy is reviewed on a regular basis to ensure it remains current, effective, and aligned with applicable laws, regulatory requirements, and organizational objectives. The review is conducted by the Compliance Head in coordination with the Compliance function and relevant department heads. A formal review is carried out at least once every year or earlier in the event of significant changes in legal requirements, business operations, organizational structure, or risk profile.
